main_count_definition: 7 unchanged existing core definitions + 38 new implementation-linked measurements (13 price,25 financial)=45 potential measurements, not 45 independent/profitable/actually published factors.
requested_goal: At least 30 actually calculated and Gold-readback-verified measurements across economic families. Only publication receipts count toward delivery.
interpretation_rules: Characteristic values are not original long-short factor returns such as SMB/HML/RMW/CMA/BAB/QMJ.
Literature return evidence, formula fidelity, data availability, implementation correctness and Korean profitability are separate claims.
Return-association studies do not establish current Korean alpha, after-cost deployability or causal effects.
Window-only variants do not create a new economic family. Alternative volatility estimators share TOTAL_VOLATILITY.
Ratios with a common accounting identity can be collinear; use train-only selection later, not a claim of 30 independent sources of alpha.
Controls are useful for discrimination of competing explanations; do not relabel them as paper-proven profitable factors.
Null is not zero. Source/account names alone do not certify matched period, currency, corporate scope, corporate actions or historical availability.
Known_at<=formation cutoff, filing/revision vintage, and evidence of policy must accompany every financial measurement. PIT_ASSUMED and verified PIT are distinct statuses.
This document does not infer all missing fields absent from Bronze. Current adapter mapping and raw coverage must be checked separately.
All actual formula differences receive explicit new IDs; never overwrite strict existing original-definition IDs with a proxy.

accounting_contract.fiscal_basis: Latest genuinely available annual FY unless a separate quarterly contract is authenticated; no FY/Q summation or monthly carry-forward shifted as a second FY.
accounting_contract.scope: Choose and record CFS/OFS, issuer/issue and parent/noncontrolling ownership. Paired years must use comparable scope/currency/period length.
accounting_contract.guards: Positive denominators where required; signed real income retained under a fixed policy; no silent missing=0, forced abs denominator or arbitrary winsorization.
accounting_contract.time: Distinguish fiscal period end, announcement/availability timestamp, observed retrieval time and revision vintage; do not backdate latest revisions.
accounting_contract.source_status: Availability is not established by this literature artifact; implementation must bind exact account IDs and authenticated source evidence.

evidence_tiers.PUBLISHED_PREDICTOR_ADAPTATION: 관련 문헌에 수익률 관계가 보고됨. 원형의 기간·계정·단위·분모와 이번 구현 차이를 명시한 국내 미검증 대용.
evidence_tiers.CONTROL_COMPONENT: 설명·진단·재무건전성·위험 측정 또는 복합신호 구성요소. 단독 초과수익 근거를 주장하지 않음.
evidence_tiers.ALTERNATIVE_ESTIMATOR: 기존 경제 특성의 다른 추정법. 독립 alpha/경제 개념 수에 중복 포함하지 않음.

source_provenance.review_scope: Primary paper abstracts/method definitions and primary-author replication documentation were examined; not every paper was read end to end. No historical local alpha, sealed OOS or candidate-result files were read.
access_limitations: Some publisher/author PDF opens timed out or returned403; indexed primary abstracts and pinned author replication documentation were used where noted. This is not a claim of reading inaccessible full text.
